thread:
maria (Support): customer hit a 400 when calling a tool via the REST API. says parser error: \"Unexpected token ',' in JSON at position 87\". attaching request + tool args they sent.

maria (Support): request_id=rid_9c7f2a, endpoint=/v1/call_tool, model=gpt-tool-1. curl they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_tool \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool": "invoice_parser", "args": "{\"invoice\": \"/tmp/123.pdf\",}\" }'
```

maria (Support): note the trailing comma inside the nested stringified JSON for args. customer pasted payload from a Windows notepad/powershell session.

oliver (Eng): thanks — can you paste the raw server-side parse log for rid_9c7f2a? need exact error.

maria (Support): server log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-16T18:12:03Z] rid=rid_9c7f2a level=error parse_tool_args failed err="JSON.parse: Unexpected token , in JSON at position 86"
request_body={"tool":"invoice_parser","args":"{\"invoice\": \"/tmp/123.pdf\",}"}
```

sam (QA): quick repro attempt — tried paste in chrome devtools console and got same 400. looks like our parser is doing a JSON.parse on the args field assuming it's valid JSON string.

oliver (Eng): yep. two issues: 1) clients sometimes double-serialize tool args (string containing JSON) and 2) trailing commas from copy/paste. server currently calls JSON.parse on args if typeof args === 'string'. we should catch parse errors and return a clearer error message + helpful hint about trailing commas.

maria (Support): customer reports this came from our JS SDK auto-stringify path when users pass a raw object into tool call on older SDK v0.8.1. they are on windows and hit smartquotes sometimes too.

oliver (Eng): action items:
- quick fix: catch JSON.parse errors and return 400 with message: "malformed tool args: invalid JSON (hint: trailing comma or smart quotes). include raw args in logs but redact PII."
- medium: update SDK v0.8.1 behavior to avoid double-stringifying. add safe-serialize util.
- long: add lenient parser that tries to detect common paste artifacts (trailing commas, smart quotes) and surface client-side transform suggestions.

rachael (UX): for the customer-facing error, please include an example of a corrected payload and a short one-liner on how to fix in Powershell. e.g., replace smart quotes and remove trailing comma.

maria (Support): customer wants a hotfix or at least a clear error message. they are on a paid tier but blocked in production. escalation to priority 1 if we don't have a quick change.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/guard-parse-args -> staging (sha: b4f2c3).

oliver (Eng): i'll cut a small PR to wrap JSON.parse in try/catch and return a friendly error code + link to KB. also adding a server-side attempt to unescape common smartquotes and strip trailing commas if safe. leaving double-serialize detection for SDK fix.

sam (QA): i'll add a regression test with these variants: trailing comma, smart quotes, backslash-escaped windows path, double-stringified args. will run against staging once deploy is up.

maria (Support): will reply to customer with a short repro and suggested immediate workaround: validate JSON in their client before sending or remove the extra quoting layer: 
```js
// bad (double stringified)
client.callTool('invoice_parser', { args: JSON.stringify({ invoice: '/tmp/123.pdf', }) })
// good
client.callTool('invoice_parser', { args: { invoice: '/tmp/123.pdf' } })
```

rachael (UX): also propose we add a small inline validation UI in Console for manual tool calls so non-dev users get an immediate validation error before send.

maria (Support): customer confirmed the workaround works, they're unblocked for now. marking escalation resolved pending/staged fix.

oliver (Eng): noted. will link PR and staging deploy here when ready.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: hotfix/guard-parse-args @ b4f2c3 -> staging (2026-03-16T19:05:11Z).

sam (QA): regression suite passed on staging for all pasted-JSON variants.

oliver (Eng): merging hotfix to main and scheduling patch release for v0.8.2 docs + SDK update plan.
